name: WildBench
intro: WildBench是一个自动化评测框架，利用真实用户查询中的1024个任务评估大型语言模型。通过任务专用检查表和两项指标（WB-Reward和WB-Score）实现系统化和可解释的自动评估。
org: Allen Institute for AI, University of Washington
task_type: 对话, 生成, 排序
intro_en: WildBench is an automated evaluation framework that assesses large language models using 1024 tasks derived from real user queries. It enables systematic and interpretable automatic evaluation through task-specific checklists and two metrics: WB-Reward and WB-Score.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with WildBench arXiv:2406.04770v2 (2024-10-05), Sections 2.1-2.2 and 3.1-3.2, Figure 2; official repository https://github.com/allenai/WildBench and official dataset https://huggingface.co/datasets/WildEval/WildBench-V2. WildEval is the hosting organization/path, not the benchmark name.. WildBench filters WildChat-1M by length, turns, language, toxicity, semantic similarity, and device identity; three LLMs remove only unanimously easy tasks before a category-preserving 1,500 sample and human review yield 1,024 tasks in 12 categories. Two independent checklist drafts are merged into 5-10 verifiable questions. Evaluation preserves the distinct WB-Reward pairwise branch—including three baselines, five-level mapping, and optional length penalty—and the pointwise WB-Score branch with its published affine transform.
